evidence_postures.configured_composition: explicit owner handoffs exist; most are independently opt-in

minimum_hosted_composition: A valid installation-state root and exact installation identity.
A locally installed and independently admitted model-serving operation; no provider is implied.
Explicit start of the chat runtime with serving operation and, if resource observation is desired, the provisioning ID.
A separately started sentientosd with matching installation identity and provisioning ID for read-only resource observation.
Independent epistemic-state, epistemic-development, cognition, and longitudinal-history configurations for those optional developmental paths.

paths.authority_boundary: Process lifecycle and observation do not grant model, resource-allocation, host-mutation, or external-effect authority.
paths.composition: The operations CLI starts the separately owned chat runtime. Canonical startup holds installation-scoped singleton custody, checks prior child and observation custody, launches a fixed child, and publishes source/process-bound handoff plus runtime observation through installation custody.
paths.configuration: Explicit runtime start arguments include installation identity and serving operation; resource provisioning is optional. The chat adapter remains disabled unless enabled explicitly.

paths.authority_boundary: Read-only observation only; no allocation or effect authority. Shared CPU/GPU/energy measurements are not inferred from invocation counts.
paths.composition: At the bound 4ecbde4 source, the daemon explicitly selected a read-only installation observer and intended to project its verified ledger into World-State. A disposable installed fixture showed observe() deterministically failed before projection: the validated issuer catalog and revocation registry were deleted before their verifier calls, and a genuinely absent runtime-observation parent was treated as invalid instead of optional absence. These are source defects at this revision, not production observations; follow-up source repairs are recorded in the next acceptance increment.
paths.missing_or_invalid: Missing, incomplete, or invalid source custody produces explicit disabled/missing/invalid/degraded status; observation does not allocate resources.

paths.authority_boundary: Observation, interpretation, authorized state mutation, and cognition are separate owners. Retained state is historical interpretation, not current truth or effect permission.
paths.composition: Each daemon tick builds World-State, runs resident cognition using only eligible earlier persisted epistemic/self-model history, then evaluates current-tick epistemic development and longitudinal reconciliation. State writeback is separately configured and authority-gated; current-tick evidence is not consumed by same-tick cognition.

unresolved_dependencies: No live installation, serving operation, resource provisioning bundle, or running child was activated or observed in this campaign.

The lifecycle is source-composed but not shown enabled as one hosted deployment; configuration interoperability and restart behavior still require bounded acceptance in a disposable installed fixture.
